title: When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular prior-fitted networks (PFNs) work well across tabular classification problems but can fail silently at deployment when distributions shift. We propose CALD (Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement), a lightweight unsupervised monitor that triggers an alarm to warn when a PFN might fail. By finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with the test-set prediction while maintaining accuracy on an ID anchor set, CALD identifies harmful OOD batches through the resulting anchor loss, requiring no labels on test batches. We prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation under sufficiently severe shift than under ID eval, yielding a one-sided test. Across 14 datasets covering tabular and structured distribution shift, on both TabPFN and TabICL, CALD matches or outperforms baselines on harmful shifts and is markedly more resilient to benign-shift false alarms.

translated_title: 何时信任PFN：检测表格基础模型中的有害分布偏移
translated_abstract: 表格先验拟合网络（PFNs）在各种表格分类问题上表现良好，但在部署时若分布发生偏移，可能会无声地失败。我们提出了CALD（校准锚点损失不一致性），这是一种轻量级的无监督监控器，当PFN可能失败时会触发警报发出警告。通过微调解码器以最大化与测试集预测的不一致性，同时在分布内（ID）锚点集上保持准确性，CALD通过由此产生的锚点损失来识别有害的分布外（OOD）批次，且无需对测试批次进行标注。我们证明，在足够严重的分布偏移下，微调后的锚点损失期望严格低于ID评估下的期望，从而得到一个单侧检验。在涵盖表格和结构化分布偏移的14个数据集上，无论是在TabPFN还是TabICL上，CALD在有害偏移上的表现与基线相当或更优，并且对良性偏移的误报具有明显更强的鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出了CALD，一种轻量级无监督监控方法，通过微调解码器最大化与测试预测的不一致性来检测表格基础模型（如TabPFN和TabICL）的有害分布偏移，在14个数据集上表现达到或超越基线，且对良性偏移的误报明显更具鲁棒性。
